events.name: US ISM Services PMI
events.description: Survey of US service-sector purchasing managers; readings above 50 signal expansion in the economy's largest sector.

events.name: Eurozone Services PMI
events.description: Final S&P Global survey of Eurozone service-sector activity, a timely gauge of growth in the bloc's dominant sector.

events.name: US Trade Balance
events.description: Monthly gap between US exports and imports of goods and services; feeds into GDP and dollar flows.

events.name: Eurozone Retail Sales (M-o-M)
events.description: Change in the volume of Eurozone retail sales, a key indicator of household consumption strength.

events.name: US FOMC Meeting Minutes
events.description: Detailed record of the Fed's September policy meeting, offering clues on the future path of interest rates.

events.name: RBI Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Reserve Bank of India's repo rate decision, a key signal of monetary policy for the Indian economy.

events.name: US Initial Jobless Claims
events.description: Weekly count of new US unemployment benefit filings, a timely read on labour-market health.

events.name: Germany Industrial Production (M-o-M)
events.description: Monthly change in German factory, energy and construction output, signalling momentum in Europe's largest economy.

events.name: Canada Employment Change
events.description: Monthly change in Canadian jobs from the Labour Force Survey, a major driver of Bank of Canada expectations.

events.name: Canada Unemployment Rate
events.description: Share of Canada's labour force that is jobless, a core measure of labour-market slack.
